verdict.rationale: Missive's REST API is versioned by URL path (/v1/). Its reference flags breaking changes inline with dated warnings and keeps superseded fields documented as legacy aliases. However, the evidence explicitly states that no versioning or deprecation policy page exists, so the policy half of the story is undocumented. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines, a version lifecycle), evidence of more than one API version or a migration path, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: with per-endpoint example requests against https://public.missiveapp.com/v1/
The /v1 reference flags compatibility changes inline rather than via a standalone policy page
